description: The RFP project targets ACCHCO’s aging straddle‑carrier fleet and severe yard congestion during peak season, proposing a three‑phase approach of diagnostics, redesign, and implementation support. Felix Kasiske will lead the modeling effort and prepare the project plan.

timeline.entry: The RFP identified ACCHCO's primary constraints as an aging straddle-carrier fleet and severe yard congestion during peak season.
